title: Year 37 of Nebuchadnezzar II (astronomical diary VAT 4956)
summary: The astronomical diary VAT 4956 dates the 37th year of Nebuchadnezzar II, one of the firmest dates of the ancient world.
description: CFAH-3 anchor point AP-6. The diary records about thirty astronomical observations that fit only this year, fixing the 37th regnal year of Nebuchadnezzar II of Babylon. Added by the CFAH pass.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 3: Anchor Points of Ancient History," ARJ 16 (2023): 131–154, section "AP-6: VAT-4956: 568/567B.C.—Thirty-seventh Year of Nebuchadnezzar"
chronologies.note: Printed without a space ("568/567B.C."). Astronomical diary VAT 4956 fixes Nebuchadnezzar II's 37th year.
